title: Record progress
purpose: Record resumable task progress, implementation framing evidence, formal code verification evidence, or explicitly labeled live diagnostic usage.
public_hint: Use this after a meaningful implementation, formal code verification, live diagnostic usage, commit, publish, or handoff slice. If task_id is provided for an unclaimed task, the server may auto-start a checkpoint work session and return work_handle/work_id so progress is not lost. If another active claim exists, do not treat the guard as a blocker to bypass: it is protecting another agent's workspace; reuse the active work_handle, recover through FSM, wait for TTL, or coordinate handoff before recording task progress. Resolve project-specific verification contour from governed project data, and label live working-database checks as diagnostic/operator feedback, not formal code verification.
